combo_label: The Garage × Caves & Caving × Paddington Bear

entries.clue: Gritty sheet torn into squares to rub old finish off a door frame.
Shaped steel jaw sized to a nut, one of a graded set on the wall.
Long unblinking look, the hard sort Aunt Lucy taught for use on rude adults
What grumpy Mr Curry is to the Browns, always over the garden wall
Two slices with marmalade between, kept beneath a hat for emergencies
Bone-cracking scavenger whose Ice Age remains litter British caves
Hot, creeper-choked wilderness where the films place the bear's early years
Banded purple and yellow fluorspar, mined only at Castleton
Sliding bar shot across to hold the side door fast.
___ Pot: gaping open shaft on the fellside above Selside
